cytoplasm acidification causes an influx of extracellular calcium, which in turn triggers a release of calcium from internal stores.

the effects of cytoplasmic pH on gap junctional coupling.
the role of Ca2+ in the regulation of gap junction conductance in crayfish septal axons.
